# strfmt/cat

> cat(a, b, ...): the values shown as text, one after another.

truck [strfmt](../strfmt.md) · [source](../../../registry/strfmt/cat.pkg)

```
let n = 3
print cat("n is ", n, ", even: ", n % 2 == 0)   // n is 3, even: false
```

Each argument goes through `show`, so it can be an `int`, `str`, `bool`,
`u8`, `[int]` or `[str]`. It builds the string in one buffer.

## Syntax

Kind: `expr`

```
cat ( {xs: args} ) -> str
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `xs` | argument list | — |

Produces: `str`
